title: H. C. Mookherjee
summary: Elected unopposed and later describes his movement from communal politics to Indian nationalism and a duty toward the poor masses.

title: C. Rajagopalachari
summary: Explains why Union subjects require specialised constitutional study before detailed constitution framing proceeds.

title: Jaipal Singh
summary: Challenges the omission of tribal areas and several constitutional voices from the proposed Union-subject committee.

title: P. R. Thakur
summary: Asks whether the future Centre can respond to famine and communal disturbance, drawing on Bengal's experience.

title: K. Santhanam
summary: Argues that a long adjournment should specify a future date rather than leave the next sitting indefinite.

title: H. V. Kamath
summary: Attempts to prohibit further preliminary adjournment and later raises Somnath Lahiri's complaint about seized Assembly papers.

title: Somnath Lahiri
summary: Challenges the seizure of Assembly-related papers from his house and presses the President on his Interim Government role.
